exposure: Women who experienced heart failure within 42 days of delivery
Women who did not experience heart failure
Type of anesthesia for delivery (general, combined spinal-epidural, epidural)
cohort: 29 pregnancies in 25 women with dilated cardiomyopathy
finding: In women with dilated cardiomyopathy, left ventricular ejection fraction of ≤ 35% before 34 weeks gestation was associated with an increased risk of heart failure within 42 days of delivery.
mod_finding: Of the 14 women who underwent cesarean delivery, 4 experienced heart failure within 42 days of delivery.
